regressions.title: F-10 gate effectively disables polish of vision captions in photo mode (conservative side effect, reported but unplanned)
regressions.evidence: photo_build.synthetic_manifest_dict gives every step action='click' with empty element name and window title (src/pipeline/photo_build.py:22-29), so round_trip_ok (roundtrip.py:33-35) on a polished caption passes only if the caption contains a click-family verb. Vision captions are descriptive ('The Settings dialog is shown...') and typically contain none, so with [polish].enabled in photo mode nearly every caption rewrite is reverted and listed in report['polish_reverted_steps']. Pre-polish captions were never gated this way. Manifest-is-ground-truth is preserved and nothing is dropped, so severity is low; no test covers photo polish with non-None captions.
